report:
Mediales Kompartiment:
Regelrechtes Knochenmarksignal. Intakter Knorpel. Beginnende mukoide Degeneration des Innenmeniskushinterhorns. Intaktes MCL.

Laterales Kompartiment:
Impressionsfraktur des dorsolateralen Tibiaplateaus mit ausgedehntem Bone-bruise. Oberflächliche Knorpelirregularitäten in der Belastungszone der lateralen Femurcondyle. Kein fokal tiefgreifender oder vollschichtiger Knorpeldefekt. Kein subchondrales Knochenödem. Wurzelnahe radiäre Rissbildung im Außenmeniskushinterhorn (Serie 3/ Image 81). Intaktes LCL.

Femoropatellares Gleitlager und Trochlea:
Regelrechtes Knochenmarksignal. Intakter Knorpel. Regelrechte Darstellung der Quadrizeps- und Patellarsehne. Regelrechte Darstellung des Hoffa`schen Fettkörpers.

Kreuzbänder:
Intakte Kreuzbänder.

Muskulatur und übrige Weichteile:
Ausgedehnter Gelenkerguss mit verdickter Synovia und synvoialen Proliferationen. Gering Flüssigkeit in der Bursa infrapatellaris profunda.

Técnica: RMN de la rodilla. Resultados: Pinzamiento de la almohadilla grasa de Hoffa. Condropatía rotuliana. Derrame articular leve. Impresión: Síndrome de pinzamiento de la almohadilla grasa de Hoffa. Condropatía rotuliana.

Diz eklemi içi sıvı miktarı hafif derecede artmış. Çapraz ve yan bağlar normal. Lateral menisküs dejenerasyonuna yırtık eşlik etmiyor. Medyal menisküs arka boynuzu-gövdesindeki dejenerasyon üst ve alt eklem yüzeyleri ile ilişkilenen ve serbest kenarda doku defektinin eşlik ettiği kompleks yırtık ile birlikte. Posterior oblik bağ ve çevresi hafif ödemli. Posterolateral ve posteromedyal köşe yapıları bunların dışında korunmuş. Medyal femoral tibyal eklem osteoartriti eklem kıkırdağındaki kondral kalınlığın %50'sini aşmayan incelme, subkondral milimetrik çaplı fibrovaskuler değişiklikler ve marjinal osteofitlerle karakterize. Eklem kıkırdakları ve kemikler bunun dışında korunmuş. Ekstensör mekanizma korunmuş (kuadriseps tendonu ve patellar tendon, patella ve yerleşimi, femoral troklear oluk ve patellofemoral bağlar normal).

MRI of left Knee with 
-3-Plane Loc, Sag PD FS, Sag T2 FS, Sag T1, Cor T2 FS, Ax T2 FS, Ax T1 FSE

> There are linear signal intensity in posterior horn of medial meniscus, it extends into the surface, in favor of tear.
> Lateral meniscus appears to be normal.
> The contour of ACL & PCL and LCL appear to be within normal, no abnormal signal intensity is noted.
> Interstitial increased singal intensity of MCL, R/O grade 1 injury.
> Joint effusion and suprapatellar bursitis with suprapatellar and medial plicae; hypertrophy of the synovium, indicative of synovitis.
> Wearing of articular cartilage of left knee wtih spur formation, subchondral edema/ sclerosis and tiny cyst., more severe at medial compartment, in favor of osteoarthritis.
    Fissures in medial patellar cartilage and mild subchondral edema, in favor of grade  3-4 patellar chondromalacia.
> Joint effusion and suprapatellar bursitis with suprapatellar and medial plicae; hypertrophy of the synovium, indicative of synovitis.
> Mild subcutaneous edema at prepatellar to infrapatellar region.

Impression: 
1. Tear of posterior horn of medial meniscus.
2. Osteoarthritis of left knee with mark subchondral sclerosis/ edema and tiny cysts in medial femoral condyle..
3. Synovitis of left knee.
4. R/O grade 1 ACL injury.
Suggest correlation with clinical manifestation

Trouvailles: 

Il y a un important épanchement intra-articulaire avec synovite. Il y a un kyste poplité démontrant une rupture partielle inférieure avec œdème superficiel au jumeau interne. La composante non-rupturée du kyste mesure 1.7cm AP x 1.6cm transverse x 4cm cranio-caudal. 

Il y a amincissement du cartilage avec fibrillation superficielle impliquant les trois compartiments plus proéminents impliquant le compartiment interne. Il n’y a pas de région de perte de cartilage complet. 

Il y a changements dégénératifs intra-substance impliquant le corps et la corne postérieure du ménisque interne. Il y a une déchirure radiale complète de la corne postérieure avec extrusion du ménisque. Le ménisque externe démontre des changements dégénératifs intra-substance sans déchirure linéaire bien définie. 

Autrement le ligament croisé antérieur, le ligament croisé postérieur, le mécanisme des extenseurs, le ligament collatéral interne, le semi-membraneux, le muscle et tendon du poplité, le biceps fémoris distal, le ligament collatéral externe et la bandelette ilio-tibiale sont sans particularité. 

Conclusion: 

Léger à modérés changements dégénératifs plus proéminents impliquant le compartiment interne. 

Changements dégénératifs intra-substance des ménisques avec une déchirure radiale complète de la corne postérieure du ménisque interne avec extrusion. 

Important épanchement intra-articulaire avec synovite avec kyste poplité partiellement rupturé.

Findings:  There is a mild knee effusion. Normal medial and lateral menisci. No evidence of tears.  Normal ACL, PCL, MCL and LCL. Normal extensor mechanism. MRI right knee

INDICATION: Assess ligamentous injury

There is a vertical tear in the periphery of the posterior horn of the medial meniscus. No lateral meniscal tear. Complete rupture of the ACL. Complete rupture of the PCL. Extensor mechanism intact. Complete rupture of the MCL at the level of the medial jointline. The proximal fibers are squiggly. IT band intact. High-grade partial tear of the proximal lateral collateral ligament. Mild sprain of the proximal popliteus tendon. Biceps femoris intact.

Small joint effusion. Circumferential soft tissue swelling and edema about the knee. Mild strain of the vastus lateralis. Mild prepatellar bursitis. 

Subchondral fracture in the lateral tibial plateau extending for an AP dimension of 2.7 cm with underlying bony edema. Findings are consistent with an osteochondral impaction fracture. Tiny bone bruise at the posterior aspect of the lateral tibial plateau. No fibular fracture. Medial compartment cartilage is intact. Slight chondrosis medial patella. No cartilage defects in the trochlea. Small congruent at the posterior aspect of the medial tibial plateau.

IMPRESSION:

Vertical tear posterior horn medial meniscus. No lateral meniscal tear.

Complete rupture ACL, PCL and mid fibers of the MCL.

High-grade partial tear proximal LCL. Sprain of proximal popliteus.

Hairline subchondral fracture lateral tibial plateau with diffuse underlying bony edema. Tiny bone bruise posterior aspect lateral tibial plateau. Small bone bruise posterior aspect medial tibial plateau.

> Increased fat stranding and minimal fluid accumulation located along the semimembrance tendon and MCL, R/O semimembranosus-medial collateral ligament bursitis

Impression: 
1. Grade 2 intrasubstance signal of medial meniscus, R/O degeneration.
2. Some joint effusion of right knee and deep infrapatellar bursitis.
3. R/O Mild semimembranosus-medial collateral ligament bursitis.
Suggest correlation with clinical manifestation

MRI of left knee with -Locator, SG PD FatSat, SG T2W FS, SG T1W, CO T2W FS, AX T2W FS

Findings:
> The contour of anterior and posterior cruciate ligaments appearing within normal limit
> High signal intensity in medial and lateral meniscus without significant extending to the surface, probably due to myxoid degeneration
> Bony fragement in posterior knee joint, suspecious of loose body.
> Spur formation in left knee joint and patella with subchondral edema and cysts, indicating osteoarthritis.
> Full thickness cartilage loss of patella, suggestive of chondromalacia
> Large amount of joint effusion with suprapatellar bursitis 

Impression:
1. Osteoarthritis of left knee joint
2. Suspect intra-articular loose body in posterior knee joint
3. Myxoid degeneration of medial and lateral meniscus
4. Chondromalacia of patella cartilage
5. Large amount of joint effusion with suprapatellar bursitis 

Suggest correlation with clinical manifestation and further evaluation.

Right knee MRI:

INDICATION: Assess block knee and context of known medial meniscus injury.

COMPARISON: Compare with right knee radiographs from [Date].

FINDINGS:

Moderate right knee effusion. No Baker's cyst.

ANTERIOR COMPARTMENT:
Preserved cartilage. Extensor mechanism is intact. Minimal soft tissue infiltration surrounding the anterior aspect of the knee. Prominent medial plica without definite insinuation into the patellofemoral compartment.

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:
Preserved cartilage. Bucket-handle tear involving the anterior horn, body and posterior horn of medial meniscus with a flipped fragment in the intercondylar notch. The flipped fragment measures around 2.1 x 0.5 x 0.6 cm. Medial collateral ligament partially covered on the field of view appears intact. Partially covered pes anserine tendons are also intact.

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Preserved cartilage. No discrete meniscal tear. Lateral collateral ligament, popliteus tendons, and biceps femoris tendons are intact. Iliotibial band unremarkable.

INTERCONDYLAR COMPARTMENT:
Anterior cruciate ligament and posterior cruciate ligament are intact.

Portions visualized of muscle bulk and may neurovascular structures are unremarkable.

IMPRESSION:
1. Bucket-handle tear of the medial meniscus with displaced fragment in the intercondylar notch. No significant chondrosis. No other meniscal fragment visualized.
2. Moderate knee joint effusion
3. Lateral meniscus is intact.
